# Aşkın Kadir Çekim

> Personal portfolio of Aşkın Kadir Çekim, a computer science student at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology who builds applied AI products, agents, learning tools and software systems.

Use the Markdown portfolio for the concise, machine-readable account of Aşkın's profile, selected projects, professional experience, technical skills and official links. Project claims are grounded in Aşkın's supplied CV and the linked first-party project listings. OmmaWorks ended in September 2026.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio in Markdown](https://cekim.eu/index.md): Complete text version of the portfolio and selected work.
- [Human-readable portfolio](https://cekim.eu/): Interactive visual portfolio.

## Selected projects

- [Peyk](https://devpost.com/software/peyk-knocks-only-when-it-matters): Proactive Telegram assistant that watches connected information, prioritizes interruptions and requires approval before sending.
- [Tesseract Go](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/tesseract-ki-mathe-assistent/id6776019680): iOS STEM learning app that generates animated explanations.
- [Twinify](https://devpost.com/software/twinify-your-ai-powered-digital-twin-for-whatsapp): Award-winning WhatsApp digital-twin project.
- [UNITE](https://devpost.com/software/unite-government-procurement-platform): EUvsVirus challenge-winning crisis procurement platform.
